notes: The clause לֹא יָסְפוּ עוֹד לָבוֹא writes two morphemes of repetition against the ASV's single more. The word goes to עוֹד, whose lexeme it directly writes (rule 24), and יָסַף is unrepresented under rule 22; the competing reading gives more to יָסַף under rule 56 and leaves עוֹד unrepresented.
The לְ of לָבוֹא is unrepresented because the recasting writes no function word for it, while the infinitive takes the supplied subject pronoun (rules 40, 48, 52).
